story_headline: Record your ride in one swipe.
post_subline: Add the Glamis Guide Record control to Control Center. Swipe down and tap to record your ride.
caption:
Add the Glamis Guide Record control to Control Center.
Swipe down, tap, and your ride is recording.
No hunting for the app when the group is already rolling.
Free on the App Store. Link in bio.
